home.heroSubtitle: Three generations of the Bazzani family, the palms our grandfather planted, our grandmother's recipes, and the lake just a few steps away. We welcome you the way you welcome an old friend.
home.letterTitle: When you arrive, you'll feel the lake right away
home.letterBody: We're not a big hotel. We're a family that, for three generations, has opened the same door to those who choose to stop in Salò. Our grandfather planted the palms that will greet you on the terrace. Our grandmother left the recipes our chef still follows, comma for comma. We try to keep all of this alive — the smell of fresh bread in the morning, the lake's light through the olive trees, an unhurried conversation after dinner. Our home is your home.
home.introText: Hotel Conca d'Oro is not a company — it's the home the Bazzani family has been opening for three generations. A bowl of palms between the lake and the hills, where time slows down and every guest comes back as a friend.
home.highlightsTitle: What you'll take home with you

lake.title: The lake, a few steps away
lake.text: Open the window in the morning and you can hear the water. From our garden the lakefront and the old town of Salò are a slow walk away.

restaurant.title: Grandma's kitchen
restaurant.text: Family recipes, ingredients from farmers we know by name, lake fish and olive oil from the Riviera dei Limoni.

park.title: Grandfather's palms
park.text: He planted them seventy years ago. Today they shade your breakfast and frame your sunset aperitif.

family.title: Our door, our welcome
family.text: We open it ourselves. We make sure the coffee is ready, we tell you where to go, we say goodbye by name.

home.roomsTeaserTitle: 39 rooms, each with its own story
home.roomsTeaserText: We took care of them one by one, keeping the soul of the house. From the Classic rooms looking onto the garden to the Lake View ones, where water is the first thing you'll see in the morning.
home.restaurantTeaserTitle: Flavours of Garda, a Brescian heart
home.restaurantTeaserText: Our dishes tell a precise geography: lake fish, the spits of Brescia, Riviera olive oil, vegetables from gardens a few kilometres away. Family recipes, not chef tricks.
home.reviewsTitle: Voices of those who came back

reviews.text: They welcomed us like relatives. Breakfast on the terrace, beneath the palms, is an image we take home with us every year.
reviews.author: Laura G.

reviews.text: The lake is right there, true, just a few steps away. But it's the kitchen we fell in love with: Brescian, simple, made with care.
reviews.author: Markus W.

reviews.text: We've been coming back for eight years. Our son calls Salò 'the hotel with the palms'. To us, it's home.
reviews.author: The Rossi Family

rooms.title: A stay between lake and tradition
rooms.intro: Our 39 rooms are split between the historic building and the wing offering the most open views over Lake Garda. Natural materials, warm fabrics and renovated bathrooms: everything designed for a genuine rest.

types.name: Classic
types.description: Cosy rooms facing the garden or the inner courtyard, furnished with light wood and neutral fabrics.

types.name: Superior
types.description: More spacious, some with a balcony overlooking the garden and the palm terrace.

types.name: Lake View
types.description: Our brightest rooms, with a direct view of Lake Garda and a window onto the mountains.

rooms.policy: Check-in from 2:00 PM, check-out by 11:00 AM. For late arrivals please get in touch — we will always find a tailored solution.

restaurant.title: Brescian cuisine, every day
restaurant.intro: In our restaurant we bring the flavours of the territory to the table: lake fish, traditional spits, Valle Sabbia cheeses and extra-virgin olive oil from the Riviera dei Limoni.
restaurant.conceptText: Family recipes passed down, local suppliers we know by name, seasonality as a rule. Every dish tells a piece of our Garda.
restaurant.menuText: Our menu changes with the seasons. We guide you through the choice with pairings of Brescian and Valtènesi wines.
restaurant.terraceText: In warm months, dining on the terrace among century-old palms and warm lights is a ritual our guests return for every year.

story.title: Seventy years of mornings on the lake
story.intro: Three generations, one home. Hotel Conca d'Oro is the story of a family that learned to host in the simplest way: by opening their own door.
story.pullQuote: “When a guest arrives, first you offer them a coffee. Then we'll see.” — Grandfather Carlo

timeline.title: An inn with nine tables
timeline.text: Carlo and Maria Bazzani open a small inn a few steps from the lake. He welcomes the guests, she takes care of the kitchen. The palms will arrive a year later, from a friend's nursery.

timeline.title: Thirty-nine doors to open
timeline.text: The second generation expands the inn: 39 rooms and a terrace overlooking the palms grandfather planted. The kitchen stays grandmother's.

timeline.title: Restoration, not renovation
timeline.text: We renovate rooms and bathrooms while keeping the original floors, grandfather's window frames, the courtyard light. Change without betraying.

timeline.title: The third generation opens for you
timeline.text: We still take care of every detail personally. We open the shutters of all 39 rooms every morning. We turn off the terrace lights last every evening.

values.title: You arrive as guests, you leave as friends
values.text: We remember your name, how you take your coffee, what time you like breakfast. They're small things — they make all the difference.

values.title: Our Garda on your plate
values.text: Our suppliers are fishermen, farmers, oil-millers who work just kilometres away. We know them by name — and you can taste it.

values.title: Lake time
values.text: There's no hurry here. The bowl of palms shelters from the wind and from the clock. We invite you to slow down with us.

gallery.title: Glimpses of the hotel
gallery.intro: The garden, the rooms, the terrace, the restaurant dishes: images that tell the story better than a thousand words.

contact.title: Write to us, call us, drop by
contact.intro: We'll be happy to answer your questions and help you plan your tailor-made stay.
